title: Nothing.
summary: This lint has been deprecated Clippy puts this lint in the deprecated group, at the level none.

title: Searches for implementations of the Into<..> trait and suggests to implement From<..> instead.
summary: According the std docs implementing From<..> is preferred since it gives you Into<..> for free where the reverse isn’t true. Clippy puts this lint in the style group, at the level warn.

title: Checks if we’re passing a c_void raw pointer to {Box,Rc,Arc,Weak}::from_raw(_)
summary: When dealing with c_void raw pointers in FFI, it is easy to run into the pitfall of calling from_raw with the c_void pointer. The type signature of Box::from_raw is fn from_raw(raw: *mut T) -> Box<T>, so if you pass a *mut c_void you will get a Box<c_void> (and similarly for Rc, Arc and Weak). For this to be safe, c_void would need to have the same memory layout as the original type, which is often not the case. Clippy puts this lint in the suspicious group, at the level warn.

title: Checks for function invocations of the form primitive::from_str_radix(s, 10)
summary: This specific common use case can be rewritten as s.parse::<primitive>() (and in most cases, the turbofish can be removed), which reduces code length and complexity. Clippy puts this lint in the style group, at the level warn.
